name: LongDocURL
intro: LongDocURL是一个综合性的多模态长文档基准测试，旨在评估大型视觉语言模型在长文档理解、数值推理和跨元素定位方面的能力。现有基准测试在处理页数和布局元素定位分析方面存在局限。该基准测试定义了长文档理解、数值推理和跨元素定位三个主要任务类别，并包含20个子任务。它通过半自动化构建流程收集了2,325个高质量问答对，覆盖超过33,000页文档，显著优于现有基准。
org: Tsinghua University, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI), Institute of Automation Chin
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
intro_en: LongDocURL is a comprehensive multimodal long document benchmark designed to evaluate large vision-language models' abilities in long document understanding, numerical reasoning, and cross-element localization. Existing benchmarks have limitations in handling page counts and layout element localization analysis. This benchmark defines three main task categories: long document understanding, numerical reasoning, and cross-element localization, comprising 20 sub-tasks. It collects 2,325 high-quality QA pairs through a semi-automated construction process, covering over 33,000 pages, significantly surpassing existing benchmarks.

drawio_review_note:
Aligned with arXiv:2412.18424. LongDocURL defines three primary task categories, Understanding, Numerical Reasoning, and Cross-Element Locating, and expands them into 20 subtasks by answer evidence pages and element types. Its semi-automated construction pipeline crawls about 200k PDF documents from CommonCrawl, filters English documents of suitable page length, classifies document type, retains 396 documents, parses text, layout, tables, and bounding boxes, generates QA pairs through multi-step prompts, verifies task relevance, format correctness, and faithfulness automatically, and then uses human criteria rechecking, extra visual-source annotation, and cross-checking. The final benchmark contains 2,325 QA pairs across more than 33,000 document pages.

Bilingual Draw.io bundle synchronized from benchmark_importer after paper and official-source review. The Chinese and English specs use identical node IDs, semantic types, coordinates, edges, and waypoints; strict Draw.io validation, XML and link checks, and rendered-image visual review passed before publication.
